name: Inventory Combine
description: Item on item, item on world, and a refusal that is worth reading. Combination rules are declared pairs producing a result, and the interesting part is the failure path: a generic 'that doesn't work' teaches nothing and is the reason adventure games acquired a reputation for moon logic, so a rule may carry its own refusal line and the component emits it rather than a shrug. Order-insensitivity is the default because a player who tries the rope on the hook should not have to try the hook on the rope. Consumed inputs are declared per rule, since some combinations spend both halves and some spend neither.

inputs.name: rules
inputs.description: Combination rules: the two subjects, the result, what is consumed, and an optional refusal line. Required.

inputs.name: orderInsensitive
inputs.description: Whether A-on-B and B-on-A are the same rule. True saves players from guessing the author's mind.

inputs.name: defaultRefusal
inputs.default: That doesn't seem to go together.
inputs.description: Said when a pair has no rule and no line of its own.

outputs.name: lastResult
outputs.description: What the most recent combination produced, or null.

outputs.name: knownRules
outputs.description: Rules loaded, for a completion display.
